title: Schedule toolbar and filters
lede: Staff and students on /schedule get a compact command row, searchable sport, a real Filters panel, and Clear that leaves My shifts alone.

sections.heading: Visual comparison
sections.note: After-only. No trustworthy before capture: the checkout already had Schedule infinite-scroll work, and authenticated /schedule was login-gated (307 to /login) during this pass. Do not treat this page as matched visual proof.

changes.was: View, a five-way Venue toggle, Sport, a My Shifts switch, and Filters all sat on one wrapping sticky row.
changes.now: View, a My shifts pressed button, searchable Sport, Filters, and Clear. Venue moved into the panel.

changes.was: Nested FilterChips inside a popover for Area and Coverage, with Venue always on the bar.
changes.now: Venue, Area, and Coverage are 40px toggle groups. Older records stays a labeled switch with explanation.

changes.was: Clear all lived only inside the popover and treated student-default My shifts as a filter, so Clear turned their default off.
changes.now: Clear is on the bar and resets sport, venue, area, coverage, older records, queue, and date windows. My shifts stays a preference.

changes.was: Date-window deep links had no chip. Week and calendar empty states mentioned filters with no action.
changes.now: Date windows get a removable chip. List, week, and calendar empty states can clear the same filters.

changesNote: Text comparison only. Captures were not available.
verification: eslint on the touched Schedule and FilterChip files: pass
npm run verify:docs after npm run codemap: pass

Authenticated browser proof: blocked. Local preview now redirects /schedule to /login (307). Earlier in the session it returned 500 from a corrupted .next tree. No session was minted.
notes: Baseline captures were not taken before this pass.
FilterChip search is shared: Bookings and Trade Board option lists with eight or more choices also get a search field.
Restart or sign into the local preview to click through View, Sport search, Filters, Clear, and week/calendar empty recovery.
